notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45262227/dbc7e04affd8623f8b01616d43d49416b6f05e91.png[/img]

Hello Hackhub community!

Great news: a free trial version of Hackhub is launching on November 4th! This is your chance to experience our game, complete missions, and get a taste of the hacking world at no cost.

Don't miss out on this opportunity! Mark your calendars and get ready to dive in.

See you in Hackhub!

notes.title: 📣 HackHub Free Trial Launching on November 4th!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053294/a7cf99278d5c7d03c27a10646190a6d192cabbae.png[/img]

Eager to try HackHub Free Trial? Soon, you’ll be able to dive into this immersive game completely free! The release is set for November 4th at 11:00 AM (CEST) / 02:00 AM (PT).

For players skilled in hacking games, completing the trial version should take around 50 minutes. It’s the perfect chance to test your abilities!
